import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Circle, Wedge
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import matplotlib.font_manager as fm

# Register Noto Sans if available; fallback to DejaVu Sans
font_path = None
for path in fm.findSystemFonts():
    if 'NotoSansCJK' in path and 'Regular' in path:
        font_path = path
        break

if font_path:
    prop = fm.FontProperties(fname=font_path)
else:
    prop = fm.FontProperties(family='DejaVu Sans')

plt.rcParams['font.family'] = prop.get_name()
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

# ============================================================
# DATA
# ============================================================
companies = [
    ("NVIDIA", "NVDA", 4.820, "USA"),
    ("Alphabet", "GOOG", 4.025, "USA"),
    ("Apple", "AAPL", 3.871, "USA"),
    ("Microsoft", "MSFT", 3.123, "USA"),
    ("Amazon", "AMZN", 2.685, "USA"),
    ("Broadcom", "AVGO", 1.889, "USA"),
    ("TSMC", "TSM", 1.884, "Taiwan"),
    ("Saudi Aramco", "2222.SR", 1.774, "Saudi Arabia"),
    ("Meta", "META", 1.712, "USA"),
    ("Tesla", "TSLA", 1.459, "USA"),
    ("Berkshire", "BRK-B", 1.024, "USA"),
]

countries = {
    "USA": 15,
    "Taiwan": 1,
    "Saudi Arabia": 1,
    "South Korea": 1,
    "China": 1,
    "Netherlands": 1,
}

# ============================================================
# STYLE CONSTANTS
# ============================================================
BG = "#0B0F1A"          # deep navy background
PANEL = "#111827"       # slightly lighter panel
ACCENT_GOLD = "#F59E0B"
ACCENT_BLUE = "#3B82F6"
ACCENT_CYAN = "#06B6D4"
ACCENT_WHITE = "#F3F4F6"
TEXT_MUTED = "#9CA3AF"
TEXT_BODY = "#D1D5DB"

# ============================================================
# FIGURE SETUP (portrait 1080 x 1920)
# ============================================================
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.8, 19.2), facecolor=BG)
ax.set_xlim(0, 1080)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1920)
ax.axis('off')
ax.set_facecolor(BG)

# Helper to draw text

def draw_text(x, y, text, size=14, color=TEXT_BODY, weight='normal', ha='left', va='top', family=None):
    ax.text(x, y, text, fontsize=size, color=color, weight=weight,
            ha=ha, va=va, fontproperties=prop if family is None else family)

# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
draw_text(540, 1860, "THE WORLD'S MOST VALUABLE COMPANIES", size=28, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold', ha='center')
draw_text(540, 1820, "Market Capitalization Snapshot  ·  Mid-2025", size=14, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center')

# Horizontal rule
ax.plot([80, 1000], [1790, 1790], color="#1F2937", lw=1.5)

# ============================================================
# HERO STAT: NVIDIA
# ============================================================
hero_y = 1700
# Subtle glow behind number
circle = Circle((540, hero_y), 220, color="#1E3A5F", alpha=0.25, zorder=0)
ax.add_patch(circle)

draw_text(540, hero_y + 60, "$4.82", size=96, color=ACCENT_GOLD, weight='bold', ha='center', va='center')
draw_text(540, hero_y - 30, "TRILLION", size=28, color=ACCENT_GOLD, weight='bold', ha='center', va='center')
draw_text(540, hero_y - 80, "NVIDIA  ·  NVDA  ·  Rank #1 Worldwide", size=16, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center', va='center')

# Quick hero stats row
hero_stats = [
    ("10,796", "Companies Tracked"),
    ("$142.9 T", "Total Global Market Cap"),
    ("11", "Trillion-Dollar Firms"),
]
for i, (val, lbl) in enumerate(hero_stats):
    x = 160 + i * 380
    draw_text(x, 1450, val, size=22, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold', ha='center')
    draw_text(x, 1415, lbl, size=12, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center')

# ============================================================
# SECTION: THE TRILLION-DOLLAR CLUB (scaled bar chart)
# ============================================================
section_y = 1350
draw_text(80, section_y, "THE TRILLION-DOLLAR CLUB", size=20, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold')
draw_text(80, section_y - 30, "Eleven companies have crossed the $1 trillion threshold. The gap between the top 5 and the rest is extreme.",
          size=12, color=TEXT_MUTED)

# Bar chart area
chart_top = section_y - 70
bar_max_w = 860
bar_h = 28
bar_gap = 10
max_val = companies[0][2]

for i, (name, ticker, val, country) in enumerate(companies):
    y = chart_top - i * (bar_h + bar_gap)
    bar_w = (val / max_val) * bar_max_w
    # gradient-ish color: top 5 gold -> blue, rest muted blue
    if i < 5:
        color = ACCENT_GOLD if i == 0 else ACCENT_BLUE
    else:
        color = "#4B5563"
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((80, y - bar_h), bar_w, bar_h,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=4",
                          facecolor=color, edgecolor='none', alpha=0.9)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    # Label
    draw_text(90, y - bar_h/2 - 1, f"{i+1}. {name}  ({ticker})", size=11, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold', va='center')
    # Value
    draw_text(90 + bar_w + 10, y - bar_h/2 - 1, f"${val:.3f} T", size=11, color=TEXT_BODY, va='center')

# Annotation for top 5 combined
anno_y = chart_top - 5 * (bar_h + bar_gap) - 20
draw_text(80, anno_y, "Top 5 combined:  $18.5 T  ·  ~13% of all tracked public company value", size=12, color=ACCENT_CYAN, weight='bold')

# ============================================================
# SECTION: COUNTRY & REGIONAL DOMINANCE
# ============================================================
country_y = 720
draw_text(80, country_y, "COUNTRY & REGIONAL DOMINANCE", size=20, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold')
draw_text(80, country_y - 30, "15 of the top 20 companies are headquartered in the United States.", size=12, color=TEXT_MUTED)

# Waffle / grid visualization: 20 squares, 15 blue (USA), 5 accent colors for others
sq_size = 36
sq_gap = 8
grid_start_x = 80
grid_start_y = country_y - 90

country_colors = {
    "USA": ACCENT_BLUE,
    "Taiwan": ACCENT_CYAN,
    "Saudi Arabia": "#10B981",
    "South Korea": "#F43F5E",
    "China": "#EF4444",
    "Netherlands": "#8B5CF6",
}

# Build 20 items list
items = []
for c, n in countries.items():
    items.extend([c] * n)
# Draw 4 rows x 5 cols
for idx, c in enumerate(items):
    row = idx // 5
    col = idx % 5
    x = grid_start_x + col * (sq_size + sq_gap)
    y = grid_start_y - row * (sq_size + sq_gap)
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), sq_size, sq_size,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=6",
                          facecolor=country_colors[c], edgecolor='none', alpha=0.9)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    if c != "USA":
        # small label inside
        draw_text(x + sq_size/2, y + sq_size/2 - 1, c[:2].upper(), size=9, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold', ha='center', va='center')

# Legend
legend_x = grid_start_x + 5 * (sq_size + sq_gap) + 40
legend_y = grid_start_y
for i, (c, color) in enumerate(country_colors.items()):
    y = legend_y - i * 34
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((legend_x, y - 10), 16, 16, boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=3",
                          facecolor=color, edgecolor='none')
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    draw_text(legend_x + 24, y - 2, f"{c}  ({countries[c]})", size=12, color=TEXT_BODY, va='center')

# ============================================================
# SECTION: SECTOR CONCENTRATION
# ============================================================
sector_y = 400
draw_text(80, sector_y, "SECTOR CONCENTRATION", size=20, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold')

sector_text = (
    "Technology and semiconductor companies dominate the upper ranks.\n"
    "NVIDIA, Broadcom, TSMC, and Apple derive significant revenue from chips or consumer electronics.\n"
    "Software and internet platforms — Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta — fill out the rest of the top tier.\n"
    "Non-tech entries in the top 11: Saudi Aramco (oil & gas), Tesla (automotive/energy), Berkshire Hathaway (conglomerate)."
)
# Draw wrapped text manually line by line
lines = sector_text.split('\n')
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    draw_text(80, sector_y - 40 - i * 26, line, size=13, color=TEXT_BODY)

# ============================================================
# SECTION: PUTTING IT IN PERSPECTIVE (closing insight)
# ============================================================
persp_y = 220
draw_text(80, persp_y, "PUTTING IT IN PERSPECTIVE", size=20, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold')

# Big stat boxes
box_w = 280
box_h = 90
box_gap = 20
box_data = [
    ("~0.09%", "of tracked firms", "= Top 10 companies"),
    ("~18%", "of total global value", "held by just 10 firms"),
    ("9×", "valuation drop", "from Rank 1 to Rank 20"),
]
for i, (big, sub, desc) in enumerate(box_data):
    x = 80 + i * (box_w + box_gap)
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x, persp_y - 120), box_w, box_h,
                          boxstyle="round,pad=0,rounding_size=8",
                          facecolor=PANEL, edgecolor="#374151", lw=1)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    draw_text(x + box_w/2, persp_y - 50, big, size=32, color=ACCENT_GOLD, weight='bold', ha='center', va='center')
    draw_text(x + box_w/2, persp_y - 82, sub, size=13, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center', va='center')
    draw_text(x + box_w/2, persp_y - 105, desc, size=11, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center', va='center')

# Closing line
closing = (
    "NVIDIA alone is worth more than the combined market cap of the bottom 5,000+ tracked companies.  ·  "
    "Top 10 hold ~$25.4 T out of $142.9 T total across 10,796 companies."
)
draw_text(540, 50, closing, size=12, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center', va='center')

# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
fig.savefig('/app/output/final_poster.png', dpi=200, facecolor=BG, edgecolor='none',
            bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.1)
plt.close()

print("Saved /app/output/final_poster.png")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Circle, Rectangle
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import matplotlib.font_manager as fm

# ============================================================
# FONT SETUP
# ============================================================
font_candidates = [
    "Noto Sans CJK SC",
    "Noto Sans CJK JP",
    "Noto Sans CJK KR",
    "DejaVu Sans",
    "Liberation Sans",
]
font_name = None
for candidate in font_candidates:
    try:
        fm.findfont(fm.FontProperties(family=candidate))
        font_name = candidate
        break
    except Exception:
        continue
if font_name is None:
    font_name = "sans-serif"

plt.rcParams['font.family'] = font_name
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

# ============================================================
# DATA
# ============================================================
companies = [
    ("NVIDIA", "NVDA", 4.820, "USA"),
    ("Alphabet", "GOOG", 4.025, "USA"),
    ("Apple", "AAPL", 3.871, "USA"),
    ("Microsoft", "MSFT", 3.123, "USA"),
    ("Amazon", "AMZN", 2.685, "USA"),
    ("Broadcom", "AVGO", 1.889, "USA"),
    ("TSMC", "TSM", 1.884, "Taiwan"),
    ("Saudi Aramco", "2222.SR", 1.774, "Saudi Arabia"),
    ("Meta", "META", 1.712, "USA"),
    ("Tesla", "TSLA", 1.459, "USA"),
    ("Berkshire Hathaway", "BRK-B", 1.024, "USA"),
]

countries = {
    "USA": 15,
    "Taiwan": 1,
    "Saudi Arabia": 1,
    "South Korea": 1,
    "China": 1,
    "Netherlands": 1,
}

# ============================================================
# STYLE CONSTANTS
# ============================================================
BG = "#080D17"          # deeper navy background
PANEL = "#0F172A"       # panel bg
ACCENT_GOLD = "#F59E0B"
ACCENT_BLUE = "#3B82F6"
ACCENT_CYAN = "#06B6D4"
ACCENT_WHITE = "#F8FAFC"
TEXT_MUTED = "#94A3B8"
TEXT_BODY = "#CBD5E1"
LINE_COLOR = "#1E293B"

# ============================================================
# FIGURE SETUP (portrait 1080 x 1920)
# ============================================================
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.8, 19.2), facecolor=BG)
ax.set_xlim(0, 1080)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1920)
ax.axis('off')
ax.set_facecolor(BG)

# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================
def draw_text(x, y, text, size=14, color=TEXT_BODY, weight='normal', ha='left', va='top'):
    ax.text(x, y, text, fontsize=size, color=color, weight=weight,
            ha=ha, va=va, fontfamily=font_name)

def draw_rounded_rect(x, y, w, h, radius, facecolor, edgecolor='none', lw=0, alpha=1.0):
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h,
                          boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                          facecolor=facecolor, edgecolor=edgecolor, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha)
    ax.add_patch(rect)

# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
draw_text(540, 1865, "THE WORLD'S MOST VALUABLE COMPANIES", size=30, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold', ha='center')
draw_text(540, 1825, "Market Capitalization Snapshot  ·  Mid-2025", size=14, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center')
ax.plot([80, 1000], [1795, 1795], color=LINE_COLOR, lw=1.5)

# ============================================================
# HERO STAT: NVIDIA
# ============================================================
hero_y = 1705
# Glow
circle = Circle((540, hero_y), 230, color="#1E3A5F", alpha=0.20, zorder=0)
ax.add_patch(circle)
circle2 = Circle((540, hero_y), 170, color="#1E3A5F", alpha=0.30, zorder=0)
ax.add_patch(circle2)

draw_text(540, hero_y + 55, "$4.82", size=110, color=ACCENT_GOLD, weight='bold', ha='center', va='center')
draw_text(540, hero_y - 40, "TRILLION", size=32, color=ACCENT_GOLD, weight='bold', ha='center', va='center')
draw_text(540, hero_y - 85, "NVIDIA  ·  NVDA  ·  Rank #1 Worldwide", size=16, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center', va='center')

# Hero stats row
hero_stats = [
    ("10,796", "Companies Tracked"),
    ("$142.9 T", "Total Global Market Cap"),
    ("11", "Trillion-Dollar Firms"),
]
for i, (val, lbl) in enumerate(hero_stats):
    x = 160 + i * 380
    draw_text(x, 1460, val, size=24, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold', ha='center')
    draw_text(x, 1425, lbl, size=12, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center')

# ============================================================
# SECTION: THE TRILLION-DOLLAR CLUB
# ============================================================
section_y = 1370
draw_text(80, section_y, "THE TRILLION-DOLLAR CLUB", size=22, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold')
draw_text(80, section_y - 32, "Eleven companies have crossed the $1 trillion threshold. The gap between the top 5 and the rest is extreme.",
          size=12, color=TEXT_MUTED)

chart_top = section_y - 75
bar_max_w = 840
bar_h = 30
bar_gap = 10
max_val = companies[0][2]

for i, (name, ticker, val, country) in enumerate(companies):
    y = chart_top - i * (bar_h + bar_gap)
    bar_w = (val / max_val) * bar_max_w
    if i == 0:
        color = ACCENT_GOLD
    elif i < 5:
        color = ACCENT_BLUE
    else:
        color = "#475569"
    draw_rounded_rect(80, y - bar_h, bar_w, bar_h, 6, facecolor=color, alpha=0.95)
    # Label inside or next to bar
    draw_text(94, y - bar_h/2 - 1, f"{i+1}. {name}  ({ticker})", size=11, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold', va='center')
    draw_text(94 + bar_w + 10, y - bar_h/2 - 1, f"${val:.3f} T", size=11, color=TEXT_BODY, va='center')

# Annotation line
anno_y = chart_top - len(companies) * (bar_h + bar_gap) - 10
draw_text(80, anno_y, "Top 5 combined:  $18.5 T  ·  ~13% of all tracked public company value", size=12, color=ACCENT_CYAN, weight='bold')

# ============================================================
# SECTION: COUNTRY & REGIONAL DOMINANCE
# ============================================================
country_y = 740
draw_text(80, country_y, "COUNTRY & REGIONAL DOMINANCE", size=22, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold')
draw_text(80, country_y - 32, "15 of the top 20 companies are headquartered in the United States.", size=12, color=TEXT_MUTED)

sq_size = 38
sq_gap = 8
grid_start_x = 80
grid_start_y = country_y - 95

country_colors = {
    "USA": ACCENT_BLUE,
    "Taiwan": ACCENT_CYAN,
    "Saudi Arabia": "#10B981",
    "South Korea": "#F43F5E",
    "China": "#EF4444",
    "Netherlands": "#8B5CF6",
}

items = []
for c, n in countries.items():
    items.extend([c] * n)

for idx, c in enumerate(items):
    row = idx // 5
    col = idx % 5
    x = grid_start_x + col * (sq_size + sq_gap)
    y = grid_start_y - row * (sq_size + sq_gap)
    draw_rounded_rect(x, y, sq_size, sq_size, 7, facecolor=country_colors[c], alpha=0.95)
    if c != "USA":
        draw_text(x + sq_size/2, y + sq_size/2 - 1, c[:2].upper(), size=10, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold', ha='center', va='center')

# Legend
legend_x = grid_start_x + 5 * (sq_size + sq_gap) + 45
legend_y = grid_start_y
for i, (c, color) in enumerate(country_colors.items()):
    y = legend_y - i * 36
    draw_rounded_rect(legend_x, y - 10, 16, 16, 4, facecolor=color)
    draw_text(legend_x + 26, y - 2, f"{c}  ({countries[c]})", size=12, color=TEXT_BODY, va='center')

# ============================================================
# SECTION: SECTOR CONCENTRATION
# ============================================================
sector_y = 420
draw_text(80, sector_y, "SECTOR CONCENTRATION", size=22, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold')

sector_lines = [
    "Technology and semiconductor companies dominate the upper ranks.",
    "NVIDIA, Broadcom, TSMC, and Apple derive significant revenue from chips or consumer electronics.",
    "Software and internet platforms — Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta — fill out the rest of the top tier.",
    "Non-tech entries in the top 11: Saudi Aramco (oil & gas), Tesla (automotive/energy), Berkshire Hathaway (conglomerate).",
]
for i, line in enumerate(sector_lines):
    draw_text(80, sector_y - 42 - i * 28, line, size=13, color=TEXT_BODY)

# ============================================================
# SECTION: PUTTING IT IN PERSPECTIVE
# ============================================================
persp_y = 240
draw_text(80, persp_y, "PUTTING IT IN PERSPECTIVE", size=22, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold')

box_w = 280
box_h = 100
box_gap = 20
box_data = [
    ("~0.09%", "of tracked firms", "= Top 10 companies"),
    ("~18%", "of total global value", "held by just 10 firms"),
    ("9×", "valuation drop", "from Rank 1 to Rank 20"),
]
for i, (big, sub, desc) in enumerate(box_data):
    x = 80 + i * (box_w + box_gap)
    draw_rounded_rect(x, persp_y - 130, box_w, box_h, 10, facecolor=PANEL, edgecolor="#334155", lw=1)
    draw_text(x + box_w/2, persp_y - 55, big, size=36, color=ACCENT_GOLD, weight='bold', ha='center', va='center')
    draw_text(x + box_w/2, persp_y - 92, sub, size=13, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center', va='center')
    draw_text(x + box_w/2, persp_y - 115, desc, size=11, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center', va='center')

# Closing line
closing = (
    "NVIDIA alone exceeds the combined market cap of the bottom 5,000+ tracked companies.  ·  "
    "Top 10 hold ~$25.4 T out of $142.9 T total across 10,796 companies."
)
draw_text(540, 55, closing, size=12, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center', va='center')

# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
fig.savefig('/app/output/final_poster.png', dpi=200, facecolor=BG, edgecolor='none',
            bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.1)
plt.close()

print("Saved /app/output/final_poster.png")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Circle
import matplotlib.font_manager as fm

# ============================================================
# FONT SETUP — use Noto Sans CJK Regular TTC directly
# ============================================================
font_path = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc"
font_prop = fm.FontProperties(fname=font_path)
font_name = font_prop.get_name()
plt.rcParams['font.family'] = font_name
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

# ============================================================
# DATA
# ============================================================
companies = [
    ("NVIDIA", "NVDA", 4.820, "USA"),
    ("Alphabet", "GOOG", 4.025, "USA"),
    ("Apple", "AAPL", 3.871, "USA"),
    ("Microsoft", "MSFT", 3.123, "USA"),
    ("Amazon", "AMZN", 2.685, "USA"),
    ("Broadcom", "AVGO", 1.889, "USA"),
    ("TSMC", "TSM", 1.884, "Taiwan"),
    ("Saudi Aramco", "2222.SR", 1.774, "Saudi Arabia"),
    ("Meta", "META", 1.712, "USA"),
    ("Tesla", "TSLA", 1.459, "USA"),
    ("Berkshire Hathaway", "BRK-B", 1.024, "USA"),
]

countries = {
    "USA": 15,
    "Taiwan": 1,
    "Saudi Arabia": 1,
    "South Korea": 1,
    "China": 1,
    "Netherlands": 1,
}

# ============================================================
# STYLE CONSTANTS
# ============================================================
BG = "#080D17"          # deeper navy background
PANEL = "#0F172A"       # panel bg
ACCENT_GOLD = "#F59E0B"
ACCENT_BLUE = "#3B82F6"
ACCENT_CYAN = "#06B6D4"
ACCENT_WHITE = "#F8FAFC"
TEXT_MUTED = "#94A3B8"
TEXT_BODY = "#CBD5E1"
LINE_COLOR = "#1E293B"

# ============================================================
# FIGURE SETUP (portrait 1080 x 1920)
# ============================================================
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.8, 19.2), facecolor=BG)
ax.set_xlim(0, 1080)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1920)
ax.axis('off')
ax.set_facecolor(BG)

# ============================================================
# HELPERS
# ============================================================
def draw_text(x, y, text, size=14, color=TEXT_BODY, weight='normal', ha='left', va='top'):
    ax.text(x, y, text, fontsize=size, color=color, weight=weight,
            ha=ha, va=va, fontproperties=font_prop)

def draw_rounded_rect(x, y, w, h, radius, facecolor, edgecolor='none', lw=0, alpha=1.0):
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h,
                          boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
                          facecolor=facecolor, edgecolor=edgecolor, linewidth=lw, alpha=alpha)
    ax.add_patch(rect)

# ============================================================
# HEADER
# ============================================================
draw_text(540, 1865, "THE WORLD'S MOST VALUABLE COMPANIES", size=30, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold', ha='center')
draw_text(540, 1825, "Market Capitalization Snapshot  ·  Mid-2025", size=14, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center')
ax.plot([80, 1000], [1795, 1795], color=LINE_COLOR, lw=1.5)

# ============================================================
# HERO STAT: NVIDIA
# ============================================================
hero_y = 1705
# Glow
circle = Circle((540, hero_y), 230, color="#1E3A5F", alpha=0.20, zorder=0)
ax.add_patch(circle)
circle2 = Circle((540, hero_y), 170, color="#1E3A5F", alpha=0.30, zorder=0)
ax.add_patch(circle2)

draw_text(540, hero_y + 55, "$4.82", size=110, color=ACCENT_GOLD, weight='bold', ha='center', va='center')
draw_text(540, hero_y - 40, "TRILLION", size=32, color=ACCENT_GOLD, weight='bold', ha='center', va='center')
draw_text(540, hero_y - 85, "NVIDIA  ·  NVDA  ·  Rank #1 Worldwide", size=16, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center', va='center')

# Hero stats row
hero_stats = [
    ("10,796", "Companies Tracked"),
    ("$142.9 T", "Total Global Market Cap"),
    ("11", "Trillion-Dollar Firms"),
]
for i, (val, lbl) in enumerate(hero_stats):
    x = 160 + i * 380
    draw_text(x, 1460, val, size=24, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold', ha='center')
    draw_text(x, 1425, lbl, size=12, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center')

# ============================================================
# SECTION: THE TRILLION-DOLLAR CLUB
# ============================================================
section_y = 1370
draw_text(80, section_y, "THE TRILLION-DOLLAR CLUB", size=22, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold')
draw_text(80, section_y - 32, "Eleven companies have crossed the $1 trillion threshold. The gap between the top 5 and the rest is extreme.",
          size=12, color=TEXT_MUTED)

chart_top = section_y - 75
bar_max_w = 840
bar_h = 30
bar_gap = 10
max_val = companies[0][2]

for i, (name, ticker, val, country) in enumerate(companies):
    y = chart_top - i * (bar_h + bar_gap)
    bar_w = (val / max_val) * bar_max_w
    if i == 0:
        color = ACCENT_GOLD
    elif i < 5:
        color = ACCENT_BLUE
    else:
        color = "#475569"
    draw_rounded_rect(80, y - bar_h, bar_w, bar_h, 6, facecolor=color, alpha=0.95)
    draw_text(94, y - bar_h/2 - 1, f"{i+1}. {name}  ({ticker})", size=11, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold', va='center')
    draw_text(94 + bar_w + 10, y - bar_h/2 - 1, f"${val:.3f} T", size=11, color=TEXT_BODY, va='center')

# Annotation line
anno_y = chart_top - len(companies) * (bar_h + bar_gap) - 10
draw_text(80, anno_y, "Top 5 combined:  $18.5 T  ·  ~13% of all tracked public company value", size=12, color=ACCENT_CYAN, weight='bold')

# ============================================================
# SECTION: COUNTRY & REGIONAL DOMINANCE
# ============================================================
country_y = 740
draw_text(80, country_y, "COUNTRY & REGIONAL DOMINANCE", size=22, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold')
draw_text(80, country_y - 32, "15 of the top 20 companies are headquartered in the United States.", size=12, color=TEXT_MUTED)

sq_size = 38
sq_gap = 8
grid_start_x = 80
grid_start_y = country_y - 95

country_colors = {
    "USA": ACCENT_BLUE,
    "Taiwan": ACCENT_CYAN,
    "Saudi Arabia": "#10B981",
    "South Korea": "#F43F5E",
    "China": "#EF4444",
    "Netherlands": "#8B5CF6",
}

items = []
for c, n in countries.items():
    items.extend([c] * n)

for idx, c in enumerate(items):
    row = idx // 5
    col = idx % 5
    x = grid_start_x + col * (sq_size + sq_gap)
    y = grid_start_y - row * (sq_size + sq_gap)
    draw_rounded_rect(x, y, sq_size, sq_size, 7, facecolor=country_colors[c], alpha=0.95)
    if c != "USA":
        draw_text(x + sq_size/2, y + sq_size/2 - 1, c[:2].upper(), size=10, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold', ha='center', va='center')

# Legend
legend_x = grid_start_x + 5 * (sq_size + sq_gap) + 45
legend_y = grid_start_y
for i, (c, color) in enumerate(country_colors.items()):
    y = legend_y - i * 36
    draw_rounded_rect(legend_x, y - 10, 16, 16, 4, facecolor=color)
    draw_text(legend_x + 26, y - 2, f"{c}  ({countries[c]})", size=12, color=TEXT_BODY, va='center')

# ============================================================
# SECTION: SECTOR CONCENTRATION
# ============================================================
sector_y = 420
draw_text(80, sector_y, "SECTOR CONCENTRATION", size=22, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold')

sector_lines = [
    "Technology and semiconductor companies dominate the upper ranks.",
    "NVIDIA, Broadcom, TSMC, and Apple derive significant revenue from chips or consumer electronics.",
    "Software and internet platforms — Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta — fill out the rest of the top tier.",
    "Non-tech entries in the top 11: Saudi Aramco (oil & gas), Tesla (automotive/energy), Berkshire Hathaway (conglomerate).",
]
for i, line in enumerate(sector_lines):
    draw_text(80, sector_y - 42 - i * 28, line, size=13, color=TEXT_BODY)

# ============================================================
# SECTION: PUTTING IT IN PERSPECTIVE
# ============================================================
persp_y = 240
draw_text(80, persp_y, "PUTTING IT IN PERSPECTIVE", size=22, color=ACCENT_WHITE, weight='bold')

box_w = 280
box_h = 100
box_gap = 20
box_data = [
    ("~0.09%", "of tracked firms", "= Top 10 companies"),
    ("~18%", "of total global value", "held by just 10 firms"),
    ("9×", "valuation drop", "from Rank 1 to Rank 20"),
]
for i, (big, sub, desc) in enumerate(box_data):
    x = 80 + i * (box_w + box_gap)
    draw_rounded_rect(x, persp_y - 130, box_w, box_h, 10, facecolor=PANEL, edgecolor="#334155", lw=1)
    draw_text(x + box_w/2, persp_y - 55, big, size=36, color=ACCENT_GOLD, weight='bold', ha='center', va='center')
    draw_text(x + box_w/2, persp_y - 92, sub, size=13, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center', va='center')
    draw_text(x + box_w/2, persp_y - 115, desc, size=11, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center', va='center')

# Closing line
closing = (
    "NVIDIA alone exceeds the combined market cap of the bottom 5,000+ tracked companies.  ·  "
    "Top 10 hold ~$25.4 T out of $142.9 T total across 10,796 companies."
)
draw_text(540, 55, closing, size=12, color=TEXT_MUTED, ha='center', va='center')

# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================
plt.tight_layout(pad=0)
fig.savefig('/app/output/final_poster.png', dpi=200, facecolor=BG, edgecolor='none',
            bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.1)
plt.close()

print("Saved /app/output/final_poster.png")
